## 6. Reachability of high dt/dt_crit ratios through the engine API

Audited critical step for the 6x4x3 block: 1.519e-03 s. ``DEM3DConfig.recommended_dt`` allows at most dt/dt_crit = 0.0222, so audited fractions above that value are refused by ``IceDEM3D.__init__`` and cannot be exercised through the public API (see limitations).
